title: The proper thing a reporter should do is say, "What science?" ...To which proponents will probably just say "National Reading Panel" ....which wasn't
summary: The proper thing a reporter should do is say, "What science?" ...To which proponents will probably just say "National Reading Panel" ....which wasn't science...it is a report of correlations and best predictors.....makes no claims about interventions.
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
The proper thing a reporter should do is say, "What science?"
...To which proponents will probably just say "National Reading Panel" ....which wasn't science...it is a report of correlations and best predictors.....makes no claims about interventions.
